rationale: The agent initiated a return without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. The user requested a refund to credit card (and only to gift card if credit card refund was not possible), but the agent processed the refund to a gift card without attempting or explaining the credit card option. The agent also selected a specific tablet (gold 128GB from #W9571698) as the more expensive one without confirming with the user. While the agent did perform a user lookup and retrieved order details, the key failures are: lack of confirmation before action, not honoring the requested refund method (or explaining unavailability), and unconfirmed choice of item. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
